verdict.rationale: Unstructured's docs include an 'api-reference' section with quickstarts that provide runnable Python/cURL/Postman code samples (e.g. docs-18, docs-31, docs-4/19/30), giving developers copy-paste examples to try. However, a direct probe for an OpenAPI/Swagger-style interactive spec returned 404 on all standard paths, indicating no live in-browser 'try it' API explorer exists — only static code snippets in prose docs. Missing for 10: a genuine interactive API console (e.g., Swagger UI/Redoc with live request execution), independent confirmation of an in-browser sandbox, and evidence the reference examples can be executed directly from the docs site rather than copied to an external client.
